jobs.prompt:
Goal g-625a8283 (owner order): the orchestrator may approve a change-order scope split itself, but only when code proves the split is safe; otherwise the owner approves. Implement it as a swarm-side gate, never a general guard loosening.

1. Approved-set snapshot. In tools/scope-commands.mjs cmdApprove, after a successful approval (owner or auto), write .swarm/project/approved-tickets.json = {at, by, ticketsHash, changeOrderIds: [ids in ledger.changeOrders at approval], tickets: [the full approved ticket objects]} (mode 0o600, pretty JSON). Nothing else in cmdApprove changes for the plain and --yes paths.

2. NEW pure module tools/split-auto-approve.mjs exporting evaluateAutoApprove({ledger, snapshot, profile}) -> {ok, conditions: [{name, ok, detail}]}. Every condition is evaluated and reported (do not stop at the first failure). Conditions:
  a. snapshot: a snapshot exists with a tickets array; else fail 'no approved-ticket snapshot: the owner approves once with swarm scope approve --yes'.
  b. change-order: ledger.changeOrders contains at least one id not in snapshot.changeOrderIds (this split comes from a newly recorded change order); detail lists the new ids.
  c. no-done-cancelled: every ticket with status 'done' in the snapshot is still present in the ledger with status 'done'; detail lists any that are missing, cancelled or reopened.
  d. no-paid-lanes: no added or changed ticket (added = id not in snapshot; changed = same id but a different JSON of its fields other than status/updatedAt/notes) has a lane or agent naming anthropic or openrouter (case-insensitive, also forms like anthropic:haiku).
  e. no-migrations: no added or changed ticket has type 'migration', or a file under supabase/migrations/, prisma/migrations/, db/migrations/, migrations/, any file ending in .sql, or a path under any directory named in profile.migrations (read whatever directory/path fields profile.migrations holds; if its shape is unknown, treat any non-empty profile.migrations plus a .sql or migrations/ file as a hit).
  f. no-deploy-or-main-merge: no added or changed ticket has a file named vercel.json, netlify.toml, fly.toml, Dockerfile, or under .github/workflows/ whose name contains deploy or release, and no acceptance line matching /\b(deploy|production|prod)\b/i or /\bmerge\b.*\bmain\b/i.
  ok = every condition ok.

3. In cmdApprove add the flag --auto-ok (mutually exclusive with --yes and --accept-waves; together -> refuse with a usage line, exit 1). With --auto-ok: run every existing approval gate exactly as today (tree, wiring, screens, waves without accept, manager gate); then read the snapshot and profile and call evaluateAutoApprove. If not ok: approve nothing, append a needs-you style journal blocker {kind:'blocker', id:'auto-approve-refused-<first new change order id or none>', text:'Split needs your approval: <failed condition names and details>. Approve with: swarm scope approve --yes'} via the existing journal appendEvent, appendLog {event:'auto-approve-refused', conditions}, print every condition line and exit 1. If ok: approve with by:'orchestrator-auto', appendLog {event:'auto-approve', by:'orchestrator-auto', changeOrders:<new ids>, conditions}, append a journal note {kind:'note', text:'Auto-approved split for <ids>: all conditions passed (snapshot, change-order, no-done-cancelled, no-paid-lanes, no-migrations, no-deploy-or-main-merge)'} and print the conditions plus the normal approval output. The plain 'scope approve' without --yes keeps today's needsHuman behavior.

4. tools/orchestrator-allow.mjs: the orchestrator guard must allow exactly 'swarm scope approve --auto-ok' (optionally preceded by the existing allowed --root handling done elsewhere) and nothing else under approve: any other approve form (plain, --yes, a FILE argument, --accept-waves, --auto-ok combined with any other word, --auto-ok=x) stays denied. Change only omSwarmScopeAllowed and what it needs; nothing else in that file.

5. NEW tests/split-auto-approve.test.mjs (first import: import './_isolate-config.mjs';): evaluateAutoApprove with each condition failing alone (a..f) blocks with that condition named; all passing returns ok; a split that cancels a done ticket fails c. Guard: swarmSubcommandAlwaysAllowed('scope', ['approve','--auto-ok']) is true; ['approve'], ['approve','--yes'], ['approve','--auto-ok','--yes'], ['approve','--auto-ok','--accept-waves'], ['approve','scope.md','--auto-ok'], ['approve','--auto-ok=1'] are all false. A command-level test in a temp project (read any scope test in context that drives cmdApprove for the fixture pattern; if none fits, test the snapshot writer and evaluate function directly and say so in your summary). Do not edit tools/swarm.mjs or any file not in outputs. tests/scope-approve-managers.test.mjs drives cmdApprove in a temp project: use its fixture pattern for the command-level test. The other scope tests are left out of context because the existing approve, split and ingest behavior must not change; the coordinator runs the main ones as checks.
